title: Road to live, Design system: every measured rule row shows its own 'Measured on <version>, <date>, <machine>' sub line, passed built-site rules are listed, rules not measured yet stay in their group without it
steps: S2: Run node --test --test-name-pattern 'every measured rule row' packages/web/tracy-harness/test/template-presses.test.mjs.
expect: S1: passes: summarizeDsReadiness on JA Nova 1.0.6 gives ROLE-1 (must fix) measuredOn '1.0.6, 2026-10-13, imac', measuredPassed SCREEN-1, CON-1, UNDO-1, FONT-1 with the same stamp, IDENT-1, MODE-1, MODE-2 unmeasured with none.

S2: passes: RoadToLive with ds-live-failing shows [data-road-rule-measured] 'Measured on 1.0.6, 2026-10-13, imac' under ROLE-1, SCREEN-1 and CON-1, a Passed group, and no such line in Not measured yet.
evidence: Dev 14/10 after #1321: JA Nova j6 1.0.6 showed 'Measured on 1.0.6, 2026-10-13, imac' only inside the Paste into Claude Code prompt; a DOM scan found no sub line on any rule row (ds-live-failing replaced the step-level line, passed rules had no row)
fence: The stamp is read from each rule's own result; a rule not measured yet never shows Measured on
